entries.title: Fewer cards ask you to decide what the crew already decided
entries.body: Work the crew starts on its own, including steps that start after you merge, now reports to your first mate instead of ending on a card for you, and a card asks you only for what only you can give. A merge card now says what each step after the merge will use, and your click on Merge allows it, so that step does not ask you again.
entries.noPicture: Most of this change is in what crewmates are told, and the merge card's new line shows only when a crewmate names a step's use, which a seeded card cannot show at release scale.
